feeds.title: Street Art Barcelona
feeds.description: The latest street art news, artist interviews, gallery exhibitions, and photos from the Barcelona urban art scene. Street Art Barcelona is a collaborative platform created to support and promote the Barcelona art scene.

feeds.title: Very Private Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Very Private Gallery is an art business blog offering a list of long in-depth articles about quotes, tips, and artists with constantly updated research. Very Private Gallery was founded in 2014 to curate and communicate emerging visual art. We create content that helps artists grow. You can find articles on our blog, and videos on YouTube. We also have art and business-related coaching. Through this, our only aim is to help artists make a living from art.

feeds.title: Museu Europeu d'Art Modern
feeds.description: The Museu Europeu d'Art Modern stands as a pioneering institution, showcasing contemporary figurative artists globally. As the first living museum of its kind, it champions painting and sculpture, fostering a dynamic platform for artistic expression.

feeds.title: FrikiFish
feeds.description: FrikiFish, helmed by local artist Amelia Johannsen, blossoms into an online haven for creative exploration. With a diverse array of articles spanning various art forms, from design to street art, it celebrates emerging talent and cultural vibrancy in and around Barcelona.

feeds.title: Base Elements Blog
feeds.description: Discover, hang out and learn about new concepts and styles in the urban contemporary art scene. Located in the Gothic quarter of Barcelona, Base Elements has established itself as a leading creative space featuring street, graffiti, and urban contemporary art. It opened in 2003 and quickly attracted the attention of the local street art community.

feeds.title: Steffi's ART Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Steffi' Goddard, just blogging about art from my studio in Spain. I have specialized in commissioned artwork for home or office and regularly host art workshops for everyone.

feeds.title: The Olive Press » Art
feeds.description: This section features articles on Art by The Olive Press. It is an English-language newspaper for the expatriate community in Spain. They bring you breaking news, videos, and featured stories.

feeds.title: The Art Büro Blog
feeds.description: The Art Büro, a boutique art consultancy, curates bespoke artwork for homes, offices, and commercial ventures. Specializing in contemporary Spanish art, they offer personalized guidance to clients, designers, and developers. Their blog shares insights and discoveries, embodying a commitment to navigating the local art scene and enhancing aesthetic journeys for all.

feeds.title: Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya Blog
feeds.description: Through voices that you don't usually hear in a museum, you will discover the interiors and bubbles of the National Museum and you will be able to participate in it and enrich it with your comments.

feeds.title: The Culture Clique » Art
feeds.description: This section features articles on Art. The Culture Clique is a niche online culture and arts review magazine, catering to the Southern Spanish and Costa Del Sol ex-pat market.

feeds.title: SPAIN arts & culture
feeds.description: News on Spanish Art and Cultural Events in the UK. The Spanish government, through the Spanish Embassy Office for Cultural and Scientific Affairs in London, and in cooperation and collaboration with other Spanish institutions and organisations, promotes Spanish culture and science in the United Kingdom.

feeds.title: House of Spain in San Diego Blog
feeds.description: The House of Spain, Casa de España in San Diego is a non-profit organization that promotes cultural, educational, social, and charitable activities in San Diego relating to Spain and Spanish culture.
